observational_data: None; immutable synthetic plan/reference studies and source-hashed reruns only. Frozen metrics and eligibility were not changed.
quadrature_method: Independent Gauss-Legendre 4 integration of constitutive slowness within each unchanged parcel, max panel 2 m, checked by panel 1 m; exact analytical basement gradient integral. Fixed fields/history/porosity retained, no simulation or metric change.

diagnosis.x9200: At 20 m, step 15 of the second thrust changes clastic unit 9 height by −19.98695 m and carbonate unit 10 by +20.03151 m. The redistributed solid persists through later compaction: final −16.75366/+15.62779 m. Their different slownesses account for most of the −2.86690 ms time change. At 10 m the final change is only −0.18870 ms.
diagnosis.x6000: The 10 m run produces the dominant +3.53244 ms final change; 20 m changes −0.00964 ms. There is repeated multi-bed material redistribution from the second thrust onward. Last step 19 slip has only +0.03767 ms net difference, but collapse/deposition/compaction and later loading increase it to +3.53244 ms. Stored accommodation differs materially despite a much smaller remembered surface-marker displacement.
diagnosis.quadrature: Changing only within-parcel midpoint quadrature cannot explain the regression: the final whole-profile midpoint error is at most 0.01441 ms, while new fine-grid discrepancies change by 3.54207 and 2.67820 ms.
diagnosis.offsets: Evaluating constitutive depth using stored parcel offsetZ and remembered top offset changes the fine discrepancy by up to 0.20131 ms in these comparisons, much less than the main regression. This is sensitivity only: parcels can have different offsetX and displaced supports, so these offsets do not define a unique physical profile or surface. It is not a validated replacement extractor.
diagnosis.cancellation: At x6000 summed absolute per-unit fine-time terms improve 62.3173→43.6320 ms while net time discrepancy worsens; at x9200 they worsen 18.6076→25.6187 ms. A smaller net travel error alone does not prove better material geometry.

limits: A closed sediment budget does not prove local geometry accuracy.
No separate new velocity constitutive bug is established by these traces.
Mean-slowness attribution includes composition, porosity, loading memory, present-depth changes and within-unit redistribution; it cannot isolate those causes by itself.
The remembered top depth is a material marker, not a reconstructed continuous physical free surface.
This evidence supports transport/allocation and coupled accommodation as the primary mechanism; no metric tuning or holdout evaluation is justified.
